output.reason: A 70-year-old with severe cramping abdominal pain since last night, visible distension, repeated vomiting and no bowel movement for 3 days describes a classic bowel-obstruction pattern requiring immediate emergency imaging, IV fluids and surgical assessment.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Severe cramping pain with a bloated belly, repeated vomiting and no bowel movement for three days can mean a blocked bowel, which needs urgent scanning, fluids and surgical review. Do not eat or drink on the way. If you cannot get there safely, or you develop constant severe pain, fainting, fever or blood in vomit or stool, call 911.
differential: Mechanical bowel obstruction (small or large bowel)
Colonic pseudo-obstruction or other acute surgical abdomen

citations.limitation: Compiled ED synthesis; diagnosis unconfirmed without imaging.
